name: 06851 · Norwalk, CT
findings: ZIP 06851 (Norwalk) has 151 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06851 (Norwalk) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06851 (Norwalk) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 66 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
